description: This file contains a test suite for GatewayChannel shutdown behavior in the OpenClaw project, specifically testing that a shutdown prevents a reconnect loop after a receive failure in a WebSocket session.

classes.name: GatewayChannelShutdownTests
classes.description: A test structure for verifying that the GatewayChannel correctly handles shutdown to prevent reconnect loops after receive failures.

methods.name: shutdown prevents reconnect loop from receive failure
methods.description: Asynchronous test method that establishes a WebSocket connection, simulates a receive failure, triggers shutdown, and verifies that no reconnect attempt occurs post-shutdown.
